sn35.54:1.1: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato katham passato samyojanā pahiyyantīti || || 4-9
sn35.54:1.2: Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahiyyanti || ||
sn35.54:1.15: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tampi aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahiyyanti || || 10
sn35.54:1.16: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato saṃyojanā pahiyyantīti || || 3
